name: What permits are required for a bathroom remodel in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a bathroom remodel in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for a bathroom remodel vary by city, but generally, any work involving changes to the plumbing, electrical, or structural components will require permits. This includes moving walls, changing the footprint of the bathroom, or significantly altering water lines or electrical wiring. Cosmetic updates like painting or replacing fixtures in their existing locations often do not require permits. We handle permit applications as part of our service for projects in Pacifica, Daly City, and other service areas.
